Good Practices
Increasing awareness of Indian Standards among the Gram Panchayat members.
Educating self on the new Indian Standards and Quality Control Orders.
Procurement of goods certified by BIS only for ensuring quality and safety wherever possible.
Regular use of BIS Care App and increasing its awareness among the public for authentication of BIS Certified Goods and Hallmarked Gold Jewellery. Exploring other features of the App.
Providing valuable inputs on improvement in Indian Standards with the experience gained during use of various products.
Utilizing various learning resources on BIS Gram Panchayat Portal.
Awareness activities on BIS and its activities among the public.
